title: styloglossum johorense
intro: Styloglossum johorense, commonly known as Johor styloglossum, is a flowering plant species within the family Orchidaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Styloglossum johorense involve its ability to treat various health issues such as fever, cough, and respiratory infections, as well as its use as an anti-inflammatory agent to reduce swelling and pain. The bioactive constituents of Styloglossum johorense include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
